meta.title: chore: Improve memory usage when sharing results
meta.body_summary: Add batched sample and counting helpers on Eval and stream results in sendChunkedResults to reduce memory usage.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added streaming to share to reduce memory; reviewer will-holley left multiple inline suggestions, all addressed; merged after ~53h without numeric perf evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 359 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted memory optimization PR that merged after a round of inline review feedback and test adjustments.

review_details.concern_detail: will-holley asked why fetchSampleResults is needed over using fetchResultsBatched directly; also noted unreachable code in getResults and asked for comments and type improvements.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce memory usage by streaming results in sendChunkedResults instead of loading all results at once, using batched fetching from the database.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing memory-efficient streaming with batched database fetch and chunked upload required understanding of async iterators and progress tracking; the agent succeeded but introduced minor issues (unreachable code, redundant method) that were caught in review.

detection_detail.code_reading: will-holley carefully reviewed the code and left comments on the redundancy of fetchSampleResults, linter error, and need for comments.
detection_detail.manual_testing: will-holley manually tested with a large dataset (5000 test cases) and noted a different breaking issue, but approved the PR's approach.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or before/after memory measurements provided; reviewer manually tested with large dataset but did not produce performance data.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Fixed unreachable code, removed redundant fetchSampleResults usage, and addressed other feedback in follow-up commits.

core_change_summary.description: Added fetchSampleResults and getResultsCount methods to Eval class, and rewrote sendChunkedResults to use batched result fetching and chunked upload, while removing the old createChunks function. Also added clearResults and _resultsLoaded flag.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files were updated for new methods; commands/eval.ts added clearResults call; evaluator.ts had a fix for type issue.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implement streaming in sendChunkedResults with fetchSampleResults and getResultsCount, remove createChunks.
Fix tests and add clearResults in doEval.
Fix unreachable code (ellipsis bot flagged _resultsLoaded after return).
Address will-holley's PR feedback: remove redundant fetchSampleResults, improve code clarity, add comments.

review_signals.summary: Flagged unreachable _resultsLoaded assignment and potential bug in getResultsCount when count is 0.
review_signals.action_taken: Author fixed unreachable code in commit 'unreachable' and addressed count caching indirectly.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding comment about chunk size vs total results consistency and resetting resultsCount in clearResults.
review_signals.action_taken: Author acknowledged and planned to clear related fields; later commit 'pr feedback' removed redundant method.

review_signals.summary: Questioned necessity of fetchSampleResults over using fetchResultsBatched directly, noted linter error, and requested doc-string for sendInitialEvalData.
review_signals.action_taken: Author agreed fetchSampleResults was redundant, removed it, and addressed other feedback in 'pr feedback' commit.

review_signals.summary: Stated PR looks good (LGTM) after small improvements requested, but noted an unrelated breakage with large dataset.
review_signals.action_taken: PR merged after final fix commit.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial streaming implementation.
Multiple bot reviews within minutes, flagging unreachable code and style suggestions.
Author fixed type issue and added tests.
will-holley reviewed in detail over the next two days, leaving multiple inline comments about design and clarity.
Author addressed feedback in commit 'pr feedback', removing redundant method and adding comments.
will-holley reported manual testing outcome and gave overall approval.
PR merged after one final fix.
